Let me check the exact position. The top box boundary is [[7, 5], [7, 48], [15, 48], [15, 5], [7, 5]]. So the top box spans rows 7-15, cols 5-48.
The token is at (15,49) which is just outside the top box (col 49 > 48).
Hmm, but the image shows the token overlapping with the top box right edge. Maybe the token is at the entrance and I need to try a different direction.
Let me try:
1. UP from (15,49) - maybe it can enter the top box from the right side
2. Or maybe I need to go DOWN first and then LEFT to enter from a different angle
Actually, wait. Let me reconsider the game mechanics. The token moves along the black path. The black path forms a circuit. The token can only move along the path, not into the boxes.
So the token's path is:
- Yellow box center → RIGHT → right vertical path → UP → top box right side → LEFT → top box top? → DOWN → left vertical path → RIGHT → bottom box?
But the token can't enter the boxes, it can only move along the path.
Wait, but the yellow box IS on the path. The token started in the yellow box and moved along the path. So the boxes are part of the path.
Let me reconsider. The path is:
- Top box (rows 7-15, cols 5-48)
- Right vertical path (rows 16-35, cols 55-57)
- Yellow box (rows 32-37, cols 30-35)
- Left vertical path (rows 35-51, cols 14-16)
- Bottom box (rows 51-56, cols 40-54)
- And connections between them
The token moves along this path. When I pressed RIGHT from the yellow box, the token moved along the path to the right. When I pressed UP, it moved up the right vertical path. When I pressed LEFT at the top, it moved left along the top of the path.
But the token is now at (15,49) and can't go further LEFT. Maybe the path doesn't continue LEFT from there - maybe it goes UP into the top box?
Let me try UP from (15,49).
Actually, I realize I should look at this differently. The token is at the right edge of the top box. The top box has pegs inside. Maybe the goal is to get the token to a specific position inside the top box, or to interact with the pegs.
Let me try UP from (15,49) to see if the token enters the top box.
